items.memo:
BILL NUMBER:  S2713

 TITLE OF BILL :
An act to amend the tax law, in relation to extending the period
during which the county of Herkimer is authorized to impose additional
sales and compensating use taxes and in relation to increasing such
tax rate


 PURPOSE :
To authorize Herkimer County to impose an additional one and one
quarter percent sales tax for a two year period.

 SUMMARY OF PROVISIONS :
The bill amends section  210 of the tax law to extend the
authorization for Herkimer County to impose an additional one and one
quarter percent sales tax until November 30, 2011.

 EXISTING LAW :
Current law authorizes Herkimer County to impose an additional one
percent sales tax until November 30, 2009.

 JUSTIFICATION :
The Herkimer County Legislature passed a resolution requesting that
the New York State Legislature introduce and pass a bill to authorize
the county to impose an additional one and one quarter percent sales
and use tax for the period through November 30, 2011.

 FISCAL IMPLICATIONS :
None to the state.

 LEGISLATIVE HISTORY :
The law was previously extended by Chapter 438 of the laws of 2007.

 EFFECTIVE DATE :
Immediate y.

 EXISTING LAW :
Current law authorizes Herkimer County to impose an additional one and
one quarter percent sales tax until November 30, 2009.

 JUSTIFICATION :
The Herkimer County Legislature passed a resolution requesting that
the New York State Legislature introduce and pass a bill to authorize
the county to impose an additional one and one quarter percent sales
and use tax for the period through November 30, 2011.

 LEGISLATIVE HISTORY :
The law was previously extended by Chapter 438 of the laws of 2007.

 FISCAL IMPLICATIONS :
None to the state.

 EFFECTIVE DATE :
Immediately.
